# Babula Shots RD

> Professional photography, videography, and drone content network in the Dominican Republic. Studio, weddings, real estate, and aerial work — bilingual ES/EN, since 2020.

Owner: Michal Nikodem Babula
Contact: info@babulashotsrd.com · WhatsApp +1 809 720 9547
Rating: 4.9/5 from 98 Google reviews
Service area: Dominican Republic only
Hours: Mon–Sun, 9:00–18:00 Atlantic Standard Time (UTC-4)

## Specialized service sites

- [Babula Shots Estudio — studio photography in Santo Domingo](https://estudio.babulashotsrd.com): portraits, headshots, food, fashion, corporate, commercial studio work
- [Babula Shots Bodas — wedding photography across the Dominican Republic](https://boda.babulashotsrd.com): destination weddings, Punta Cana, Casa de Campo, Samaná, Las Terrenas, Zona Colonial
- [Babula Shots Inmobiliaria — real estate photography, video, and drone](https://inmobiliaria.babulashotsrd.com): listings, MLS, Airbnb, villas, hotels, developers
- [Babula Shots Drone — certified drone services with DJI Mavic 3 Pro](https://dron.babulashotsrd.com): real estate, construction, tourism, inspection, mapping
